definitions.gloss: to accompany; to go together with; to be accompanied by
definitions.explanation: To go somewhere together with someone, typically in a somewhat formal context. Often used when one person accompanies another to a specific destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同伴|どうはん}する。
examples.english: To be accompanied by a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come accompanied by a guardian.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{同伴|どうはん}しない⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Minors are not admitted without an accompanying adult.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb formed from ⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧, a compound of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (together) and {伴|はん} (companion, accompany). Relatively formal; often seen in rules, notices, and official contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
Can be transitive (⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同伴|どうはん}する — to bring someone along) or used as a noun modifier (⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧ — accompanied by a guardian).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧ — accompanied by a guardian
- {同伴者|どうはんしゃ} — companion, accompanying person
- ⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧ — admission with a companion
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{同伴|どうはん}→同伴：15292_douhan⟧ — accompanied by family

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ — to go together (casual)
- ⟦{付|つ}き{添|そ}う→付き添う：10585_tsukisou⟧ — to attend, to accompany (caregiving nuance)
- ⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ — to take along (casual, implies leading someone)
